name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A generative avatar drawn from a string as a mirrored dither face on a lit, dithered disc, with an overlapping avatar group.

name: divider
title: Divider
description: A horizontal or vertical dithered rule with fading ends and an optional label.

name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: A lit, dithered illustration (box, magnifier, folder or planet) with a title, a description and an action, for views with nothing in them yet.

name: loader
title: Loader
description: A small dithered loading indicator: a ring with a comet tail, three dissolving dots, a pulse or a bar.

name: logo-marquee
title: Logo marquee
description: A looping row or still wall of logos in one dithered treatment, with soft or dithered edge fades.

name: not-found
title: Not found
description: A complete 404 block with a big dithered code, a message and actions.

name: progress-bar
title: Progress bar
description: A progress bar built from dither cells: any fill texture with a solid leading edge, stacked parts, step segments and an indeterminate comet.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholders for blocks, text lines and avatars, drawn in dither, with a dense band that sweeps across or a pulse that steps through the Bayer levels.

name: stat-card
title: Stat card
description: A KPI card with a value, a coloured delta and a dithered trend area on a dotted surface.
